analysis.title: Market Rhythm Focus
key_insights: Structural breadth in the Russell 3000 is washed out, with the % of stocks above their 200dma at the weakest level since June 2025. EFG says this kind of breakdown is rarely benign unless it quickly reverses or reaches capitulation territory.
RSP (S&P 500 Equal Weighted ETF) breadth is rolling over hard and EFG says the rotation game is over. Levels to watch are the 200dma at 209.20 and the September low at 207.20.
The S&P 500 top formation has broken. EFG calls this technically ugly but often closer to the eventual low, and expects more near-term pain because 4-week highs/lows metrics have not fully flushed.
EFG says the S&P 500 is still tracking its 2018 analogue.
SPX, VIX and implied correlation have caught up with earlier warnings from high yield spreads and MOVE. EFG reads the selloff as more coherent and healthier because the market is pricing the problem.
KOSPI broke key supports just below the 5,000 handle in the 20 November session. EFG allows a quick reclaim but calls the broader setup a clear bear market that needs substantial repair to reverse.
The Hang Seng printed a poor weekly close below a major pivot that combines the June low with key 2022-2023 highs. EFG says this leaves it vulnerable to further downside.
risk_factors: Breadth breakdown in the Russell 3000 may not reverse quickly or reach capitulation.
The S&P 500 may keep following the 2018 analogue.
KOSPI could fail to reclaim the broken support just below 5,000.
The Hang Seng could extend its downside after the weekly close below the pivot.

tension_points.bull_case: The selloff looks more coherent and healthier because SPX, VIX and correlation have caught up with credit and MOVE, so the market is pricing the problem. The broken top formation is often closer to the eventual low.
tension_points.bear_case: Breadth is washed out, 4-week highs/lows metrics have not fully flushed, and the 2018 analogue is still tracking, so EFG expects more near-term pain.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A quick reversal in the % of Russell 3000 stocks above the 200dma, or capitulation territory, would change the read on breadth.
